# One Click Enterprises

> Premium supplier of doors, tiles, sanitary ware, granite, digital locks, and building materials across India.

## Overview

One Click Enterprises is a leading distributor of building materials and home improvement products, serving customers across India from offices in Delhi NCR, Jabalpur, Nagpur, and Indore. The company offers an extensive catalog including Hilton designer doors (50+ models), ceramic and floor tiles, terracotta jali and bricks, sanitary ware, digital smart locks, granite and marble, decorative tiles, adhesives, kitchen sinks, and vanity units.

## Pages

- [Home](https://oneclickenterprises.in/) — Company overview, featured products, and category highlights

- [Products](https://oneclickenterprises.in/#/products) — Full product catalog with search, category filters, and variant details
- [Contact Us](https://oneclickenterprises.in/#/contact) — Contact form, office locations, phone numbers, and social media links

## Product Categories

1. **Tiles** — Bathroom, kitchen, floor, parking, slabs, cool roof, wooden plank, elevation, swimming pool, double charge
2. **Terracotta** — Jali, floor tiles, adhesive
3. **Sanitary** — Wash basins, one-piece suites, rimless toilets, smart sanitary
4. **Doors** — Hilton designer doors (50+ models in edge, cube, and hiltz styles)
5. **Digital Locks** — Hotel, basic, advance, AI, German, palm, nuclear, glass door smart locks
6. **Stones** — Granite, marble, limestone, quartz, decorative stones, cobbles
7. **Decorative** — Pencil mate tiles, poster tiles, step riser tiles
8. **Adhesive** — JK, Roff, Asian Paints, Ultratech
9. **Kitchen** — Stainless steel sinks (handmade, waterfall, satin, plain)
10. **Bathroom** — Vanity units (wall hung, floor with legs)
